meta.name: Sheep And Wolves Pig Deal
meta.description: The united town of sheep and wolves lives a peaceful and quiet life until two unexpected guests turn up - a polar fox and a tiny ewe. No one ever expected them to bring a deadly danger, which can be overcome only if they work together. Only teamwork can solve big problems and deal with serious challenges - as there is strength in unity.
meta.slogan: YOU CAN'T PULL THE WOOL OVER THEIR EYES
